title: Stop the Substack text-selection quote popup
question: How do I stop Substack's popup when I select text?
answer: Substack has no setting to turn off the box that pops up over a post when you select text. The usermods script on this page hides that floating Share box, so you can select and copy text from a post without it covering the line you are reading. Selecting and copying text work as before, and the rest of the post is left alone.
prompt: Stop the Share popup that appears when I select text in a Substack post.
details:
When you select text in a post, Substack inserts a small floating box with a Share button that makes a quote card from the selection. The script hides that box with one CSS rule. It matches the box by the start of its class name (`popover-`) and its share icon, because the rest of the class name is a hash that changes between Substack builds.

Logged-in readers may see more buttons in the same box (such as Restack); the whole box is hidden. The check is logged out: it selects a paragraph in a post and confirms the box is added but not shown. It runs on `*.substack.com` addresses; publications on their own domain need an extra `@match` line.

evidence.note: Greasy Fork total installs: "Substack - Stop Text Selection Quote Popup" (58)

check.actions: const p = document.querySelector('.body.markup p'); p.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(p); const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); const b = p.getBoundingClientRect(); p.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, clientX: b.left + 5, clientY: b.top + 5 })); p.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { bubbles: true, clientX: b.right - 5, clientY: b.top + 10 })); document.dispatchEvent(new Event('selectionchange')); await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1500));
check.expect: (() => { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('.available-content [class*="popover-"]')].filter((e) => e.querySelector('svg.lucide-share')); return l.length > 0 && l.every((e) => !e.checkVisibility()); })()
check.intact: (() => { const ps = [...document.querySelectorAll('.body.markup p')].filter((p) => p.checkVisibility()); return ps.length >= 5 && getSelection().toString().length > 20; })()
